steps.title: Initialize application configuration and metadata
steps.description: Define application package details, app title, and package identifier in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Gradle build parameters and SDK targets
steps.description: Specify compileSdk 34, targetSdk 34, minSdk 21, Java 8 compatibility, and dependencies in Gradle build scripts.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest for system permissions and components
steps.description: Declare Internet, Foreground Service, Media Playback, Wake Lock, Post Notifications, and Audio Recording permissions alongside MainActivity, HistoryActivity, and BackgroundAudioService.

steps.title: Define UI visual style, dark theme, and color palette
steps.description: Define dark theme colors, surface elements, text formatting, and custom background shapes.

steps.title: Implement local SQLite watch history storage
steps.description: Create HistoryDbHelper and HistoryItem model classes for logging video history entries and managing database records.

steps.title: Develop watch history activity and list UI adapter
steps.description: Construct HistoryActivity, HistoryAdapter, and XML layouts for rendering watch history and enabling item deletion.

steps.title: Construct background audio service and media session interface
steps.description: Implement BackgroundAudioService with MediaSession transport controls, audio focus handling, wake lock, and ongoing status notification.

steps.title: Build paywall manager and worker verification system
steps.description: Create TrialPaywallManager to verify access status, query cloud worker endpoints, handle device IDs, and load UPI payment QR codes.

steps.title: Design main activity layout with navigation bar and paywall lock overlay
steps.description: Create activity_main XML layout featuring web control toolbar, progress bar, error state container, and scrollable paywall overlay.

steps.title: Configure WebView browser integration and JavaScript bridge
steps.description: Set up WebSettings, WebChromeClient, WebViewClient, and Java-JS interaction bridges inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Implement JS audio polyfills for continuous screen-off playback
steps.description: Inject JavaScript overrides for Page Visibility APIs and event listeners to keep media playback active when running in the background.

steps.title: Integrate native voice speech recognition and search query handler
steps.description: Implement native SpeechRecognizer integration and JS bridge to allow voice searching on YouTube.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Assemble and build the final executable application package for LockPlayTube.
